hints.title: Ratio Aggregation of Logged Events
hints.text: Group logs by question identifier and calculate the proportion of answered occurrences over total shown impressions.

hints.title: Summing Flagged Actions in Group By
hints.text: Count answer events by evaluating sum(action = "answer") and divide by sum(action = "show"). Order the resulting answer rate in descending order.

hints.title: Top Answer Rate Blueprint
hints.text: Select question_id as survey_log from SurveyLog group by question_id order by (sum(action = "answer") / sum(action = "show")) desc, question_id asc limit 1.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT question_id AS survey_log
FROM SurveyLog
GROUP BY question_id
ORDER BY (SUM(action = 'answer') / SUM(action = 'show')) DESC, question_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

variables: N: number of records in SurveyLog
complexity.notes: Group by aggregation and sorting by answer rate runs in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Joining separate show and answer tables introduces row multiplication overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Conditional aggregation sums action events in a single group scan.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of conditional sums (SUM(action = "answer")) and tie-breaking by question_id ASC.

solutions.code:
SELECT question_id AS survey_log
FROM SurveyLog
GROUP BY question_id
ORDER BY (SUM(action = 'answer') / SUM(action = 'show')) DESC, question_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT question_id AS survey_log
FROM SurveyLog
GROUP BY question_id
ORDER BY (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'answer')::float / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'show')::float) DESC, question_id ASC
LIMIT 1;
